```{r}
#| include: false
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(MASS)
load("~/Carleton/Water/data/Desiccation 2025/Tissue water content/macromolecules.Rdata")
load("~/Carleton/Water/data/Desiccation 2025/tissue.Rdata")
```

# dry mass
```{r}

mass_cor <- lm(Tissue_dry_mass ~ Start_mass * Sex, tissue_data)
summary(mass_cor)
tissue_data$fit <- predict(mass_cor)

p_mass_cor <- ggplot(tissue_data, aes(Start_mass, Tissue_dry_mass, colour = Time_treatment, shape = Sex)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = tissue_data, aes(Start_mass, fit, linetype = "Sex"), colour = "black", show.legend = F, linewidth = 0.5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Initial mass (mg)", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(200, 1000), breaks = seq(200,1000,  100)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Dried tissue mass (mg)", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, 400), breaks = seq(0,1000,  100)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Time", values = c("#c7e9b4",
                                               "#7fcdbb",
"#41b6c4",
"#2c7fb8",
"grey",
"#253494"), labels = c("0", "3", "6", "18", "Fed recovery", "Starved recovery")) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt"))
  
p_mass_cor

ggsave(p_mass_cor, dpi = 300, width = double_width, units = "mm", height = single_height, filename = "data/Desiccation 2025/figures/fS2masscor.png")
```

No three way interaction.

```{r}
full_mass_mod <- lm(Tissue_dry_mass ~ Start_mass * Time_treatment * Sex, data = lipid_data)

anova(full_mass_mod)
# Three way interaction is not significant

best_mass_mod <- step(full_mass_mod)
print(best_mass_mod)
# Model selection drops three way interaction
anova(best_mass_mod)

pairs(emmeans(best_mass_mod, ~ Time_treatment * Sex), adjust = "Tukey", by = "Sex") %>%
  broom::tidy() |> 
  filter(adj.p.value <= 0.05)
```

# lipids
```{r}
full_mass_mod <- lmer(total_lipid ~ Start_mass * Time_treatment * Sex + (1|Plate), data = lipid_data, REML = FALSE)

anova(full_mass_mod)
# Three way interaction is not significant

best_mass_mod <- step(full_mass_mod)
print(best_mass_mod)
# Model selection drops three way interaction
# Random term is not significant but keeps term

total_mass_mod <- get_model(best_mass_mod)
anova(total_mass_mod)

pairs(emmeans(total_mass_mod, ~ Time_treatment * Sex), adjust = "Tukey", by = "Sex") %>%
  broom::tidy() |> 
  filter(adj.p.value <= 0.05)
```

* Effect over time and differed between sexes
* 24 starved F were lower than 18 F


# proteins

```{r}
# Random effect is singular - remove
full_p_mod <- lm(total_protein ~ Start_mass * Time_treatment * Sex, data = protein_data)

anova(full_p_mod)
# Three way interaction is not significant

best_p_mod <- step(full_p_mod)

anova(best_p_mod)

pairs(emmeans(best_p_mod, ~ Time_treatment + Sex), adjust = "Tukey", by = "Sex") %>%
  broom::tidy() |> 
  filter(adj.p.value <= 0.05)
```

* Random model was singular so random term removed
* No time by sex interaction - same trends in males and females
* 24 Starved males and females are different to 3 and 18

# Carbs
```{r}
full_c_mod <- lmer(total_carb ~ Start_mass * Time_treatment * Sex + (1|Plate), data = carb_data, REML = FALSE)

anova(full_c_mod)
# Three way interaction is not significant

best_c_mod <- step(full_c_mod, reduce.random = F)
print(best_c_mod)
# Model selection drops three way interaction
# Random term is significant

total_c_mod <- get_model(best_c_mod)
anova(total_c_mod)

pairs(emmeans(total_c_mod, ~ Time_treatment + Sex), adjust = "Tukey", by = "Sex") %>%
  broom::tidy() |> 
  filter(adj.p.value <= 0.05)
```

* No Time by sex interaction
* 24 fed males and females different to 6 hours
* 24 h starved males and females different to 3 and 24 fed indviduals
